The season began on 25 August 2018 and ended on 8 June 2019.{{cite web|url=http://www.afa.com.ar/upload/reglamento/REGLAMENTO-B-NAC-2018-20219.pdf |title=Reglamento del Campeonato de Primera B Nacional 2018–19 |publisher=AFA |language=Spanish}} Twenty-five teams competed in the league, seventeen returning from the [[2017–18 Primera B Nacional|2017–18 season]], four teams that were relegated from [[2017–18 Argentine Primera División|Primera División]] and two teams promoted from [[Torneo Federal A|Federal A]] and [[Primera B Metropolitana|B Metropolitana]]. ==Competition format== Twenty-five teams played each other once for a total of twenty-four matches each. The champion earns promotion to the [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]]. The teams placed from 2nd to 9th place competed in the "Torneo Reducido" for the second promotion berth after the regular season ended. Two teams were relegated at the end of the season; one with indirect affiliation with [[Asociación del Fútbol Argentino|AFA]] was relegated to the [[Torneo Federal A]], while one directly affiliated faced relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. ==Club information== === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2018–19 Primera B Nacional teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
